questions.question: Write a note on the antennas used in radio telescopes. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Write a note on the antennas used in radio telescopes. [U] / [CO3] A radio telescope is a specialized antenna and radio receiver used to detect radio waves from astronomical radio sources in the sky. Radio telescopes are typically large parabolic dish antennas. These dishes reflect incoming plane waves onto a focal point where a feed antenna collects the signals. A large metal dish, often constructed from mesh to reduce weight and wind load, focuses energy, allowing detection of extremely faint signals.
  • - 5 marks

questions.question: Compare spiral and elliptical galaxies using observable properties such as star population, gas content, and structure. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Compare spiral and elliptical galaxies using observable properties such as star population, gas content, and structure. [A] / [CO4] Elliptical galaxies are egg shaped. They range from nearly perfect spheres, E0, to the flattest, E7. Elliptical galaxies seem to contain practically all old stars. They have little visible gas and dust, but infrared and X-ray observations reveal some.
  • - 2 marks Spiral galaxies have a disk with central bulge and spiral arms. They are divided into two subcategories. Normal spiral galaxies with a bright disk where spiral arms wind out from a bulging nucleus. For the Barred spiral galaxies the spiral arms unwind from the ends of a bar-shaped concentration of material. Spiral galaxies have large amounts of gas and dust in the disk and contain young, middle-aged, and old stars.
  • - 3 marks
